lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p14 - 1. Point and say.

details: Point and say checks understanding of the target word meaning and sound, and provides an introduction to the project topic.
Look for correct identification of the actions in the pictures, and correct pronunciation.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p14 - 3 & 4. When do you brush your teeth? Tick.

details: When do you…? Tick reinforces the key language from the lesson and is the starting point for a discussion about when students do the actions, adding an element of personalisation to the lesson.

Look for correct identification of the target actions and the parts of the day represented in the pictures at the bottom, neat ticks within the boxes, and students volunteering information about when they wash their hands and brush their teeth.

details: Say the chant strengthens retention of the target language and helps improve pronunciation and stress.
Look for correct stress and confident participation, with most students able to join in with at least the most repeated parts of the chant.
